name: editable
title: Editable
description: Inline editable text: a preview that switches to an input on click or focus, submits on Enter or blur, and cancels on Escape.

props.name: activationMode
props.description:
The activation mode for the preview element.

- "focus" - Enter edit mode when the preview is focused
- "dblclick" - Enter edit mode when the preview is double-clicked
- "click" - Enter edit mode when the preview is clicked
- "none" - Edit can be triggered programmatically only

props.name: autoResize
props.description: Whether the editable should auto-resize to fit the content.

props.name: defaultEdit
props.description: Whether the editable is in edit mode by default.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value of the editable when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the editable.

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the editable is disabled.

props.name: edit
props.description: Whether the editable is in edit mode.

props.name: finalFocusEl
props.description: The element to receive focus when the editable is closed.

props.name: form
props.description: The associate form of the underlying input.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the editable. Useful for composition.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the input's value is invalid.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: The maximum number of characters allowed in the editable

props.name: name
props.description: The name attribute of the editable component. Used for form submission.

props.name: placeholder
props.type: string | { edit: string; preview: string; } | undefined
props.description: The placeholder text for the editable.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the editable is read-only.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the editable is required.

props.name: selectOnFocus
props.description: Whether to select the text in the input when it is focused.

props.name: submitMode
props.description:
The action that triggers submit in the edit mode:

- "enter" - Trigger submit when the enter key is pressed
- "blur" - Trigger submit when the editable is blurred
- "none" - No action will trigger submit. You need to use the submit button
- "both" - Pressing `Enter` and blurring the input will trigger submit

props.name: translations
props.description: The translations for the editable.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the editable.

events.name: onEditChange
events.description: Function to call when the edit mode changes.

events.name: onFocusOutside
events.description: Function called when the focus is moved outside the component

events.name: onInteractOutside
events.description: Function called when an interaction happens outside the component

events.name: onPointerDownOutside
events.description: Function called when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Function to call when the value changes.

events.name: onValueCommit
events.description: Function to call when the value is committed.

events.name: onValueRevert
events.description: Function to call when the value is reverted.

examples.title: Basic
examples.source:
import Editable from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/editable/editable.marko";

<Editable defaultValue="Edit this text" class="w-[280px]"/>
examples.description: An uncontrolled editable with an initial value.

examples.title: Placeholder
examples.source:
import Editable from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/editable/editable.marko";

<Editable placeholder="Enter your name" class="w-[280px]"/>
examples.description: Shown in preview mode when the value is empty.

examples.title: Submit on Enter only
examples.source:
import Editable from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/editable/editable.marko";

<Editable defaultValue="Press Enter to submit" submitMode="enter" class="w-[280px]"/>
examples.description: Set `submitMode="enter"` so blurring the input cancels instead of submitting.

examples.title: Activation: double-click
examples.source:
import Editable from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/editable/editable.marko";

<Editable defaultValue="Double-click to edit" activationMode="dblclick" class="w-[280px]"/>
examples.description: Set `activationMode="dblclick"` to require a double-click before entering edit mode.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.source:
import Editable from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/editable/editable.marko";

<Editable defaultValue="Can't touch this" disabled class="w-[280px]"/>
examples.description: A disabled editable ignores pointer input and is skipped by the tab order.

examples.title: Custom trigger
examples.source:
import Editable from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/editable/editable.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";

<Editable defaultValue="Edit via custom trigger" class="w-[280px]">
  <@trigger|props|>
    <Button type="button" ...props variant="outline" size="sm">Edit</Button>
  </@trigger>
</Editable>
examples.description: Replace the default edit-trigger button with the `@trigger` tag parameter.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import Editable from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/editable/editable.marko";
Live value: ${value} Last committed: ${lastCommitted}
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `value` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `valueChange`, and use `valueCommit` to react only when the value is submitted.
